title: Catch Vendor Contracts Before They Auto-Renew
summary: Get a reminder well before each vendor contract, trial or subscription renews, so you cancel or renegotiate on your terms instead of paying another year.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you pay several vendors on renewing contracts; savings come from cancelling or renegotiating in time.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: You stop paying for renewals nobody meant to keep.
A reminder before the date gives you time to negotiate a better price.
who_its_for: Small businesses with several vendor contracts.
Office managers and founders who sign up for tools.

stack.name: Contract Renewal Reminder
stack.role: Tracks renewal dates from a sheet and sends reminders before contracts auto-renew.
stack.creator: Trung Tran

stack.name: Watchdog Receipts
stack.role: Finds renewals and trials hiding in your inbox that are not on the sheet yet.
stack.creator: jxckvibe

steps.name: Watchdog Receipts
steps.does: Finds renewals and trials in your inbox

steps: List your vendor contracts and renewal dates in one sheet.
Let the inbox watcher add renewals and trials it finds.
Get reminders ahead of each date.
Decide to keep, cancel or renegotiate, and act yourself.
guardrails: The bots remind and list; you cancel or renew yourself.
Read the notice period in each contract; some need written notice well before the date.
